en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a large Ottoman mosque complex with a central dome and two tall minarets beside a multi‑arched stone bridge and a river in the foreground. Low buildings surround the complex. Printed text in French at the upper left reads "Souvenir d'Andrinople. Mosquée Sultan Bayazid." and there is additional Ottoman/Turkish text at the upper right. A modern website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears at the bottom.
